description: Patch brand voice/style fields: tone, colors, defaultLocale, flexibleScheduling. They steer all future article generation. Also Brand Profile's Local business switch: localBusiness, and serviceArea (the area the business serves, like "Austin, Texas"; 100 characters at most, empty clears it). Only provided fields change.

defaultLocale.description: BCP-47 tag from the supported registry

flexibleScheduling.description: true allows 1 to 5 articles a day and lets you move planned articles by hand

serviceArea.description: The area the business serves, like "Austin, Texas". 100 characters at most; empty clears it.

tone.description: One of: professional, conversational, technical, friendly, journalistic, persuasive

name: update_brand_profile
